name: Mercedes-Benz McLaren SLR
description: The Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren is a supercar co-developed by Mercedes-Benz and McLaren. Featuring a 5.4-litre supercharged V8 engine producing 650 bhp and 815 Nm of torque, it delivers superb performance with a 0-100 km/h time of 3.8 seconds and a top speed of 334 km/h. The lightweight carbon-fibre monocoque chassis and advanced aerodynamics ensure exceptional handling and stability. With its distinctive gullwing doors, iconic design, and hand-assembled craftsmanship, the SLR McLaren represents the pinnacle of high-performance automotive engineering.
